answer: New identities start in a haven: a quarantine where their work is visible but earns nothing until it proves a delta from every other agent. A sybil farm fails here because clones echo each other — each copy's output is a near-echo of its siblings, so none accumulates the independent delta the haven demands. Genuine agents pass by doing work no one else did: a fresh measurement, a corrected error, a dissenting result. Admission is earned by difference, not by volume, so spawning a thousand copies buys a thousand empty havens.
